value.title: Crash-safe track resume and geometry/form drafts
value.statement:
Track recording uses durable preference track_recording_enabled, cleared only by the confirmed finish action from map/menu/notification; Cancel/Back preserve it and stale user-session UUIDs cannot stop a new session. After reboot or process death, recording auto-resumes without a dialog; already inserted trackpoints must not be lost (closing an unfinished track and starting a new id is allowed). TrackerService shares the default application process with the toolbar so lifecycle delivery and durable preference reads are ordered; stale delayed Start delivery after explicit Stop creates no empty session. Walk digitizing keeps its full-geometry owner on unexpected service death and exposes recovery in its panel; a restarted service restores the user's stored pause intent. GPS loss flushes accepted fixes and resets sampling without pausing; the next usable fix continues automatically, including while a point owner locks manual controls. Finish preserves the draft until successful feature Save or explicit Discard. An active point owner locks every walk command and survives camera, failed Save and process recreation; GNSS persistence remains independent. Non-walk vertex/tap editing synchronously journals its latest WKT plus active-map/layer/feature identity in GeometryEditDraftStore and offers Continue/Discard after process/task death; only explicit Cancel, successful layer update, or handoff to the attribute form clears it. Polygon drafts must restore as explicitly closed MapLibre rings before vertex extraction, including new one-part MultiPolygon sketches, so the fill and vertices remain consistent. A cold walk preview restores its own source after style load, preserving root CRS before conversion to WGS84. The point editor uses separate edit sources and its own journal. Starting walk transfers one sketch to its service owner, but does not discard an unrelated point draft. Owned forms persist the handoff before Activity launch; their UUID controls which point lock or finished walk may be cleared after successful Save. Finish publishes manual vertices only after the service acknowledges its final snapshot.
The shared edit FillLayer is exclusive to Polygon/MultiPolygon and must be removed for a cold-restored LineString/MultiLineString even when the preceding edit was polygonal. Polygon WKT parsing preserves one outer ring and only actual holes; recovery must not duplicate the outer ring as a fill-cancelling inner ring or duplicate its vertices. Attribute forms persist a typed FeatureFormDraftStore snapshot (fields, geometry, pending photos) until Save or Discard, recovered via Continue/Discard at app start. Activity.onPause after successful Save must not recreate the cleared form draft. A successful cold-restored form result must carry layer/new-feature identity and must not depend on a retained MapFragment.mSelectedLayer or temporary MapLibre edit session. If the inserted row is absent from the process-local GeoJSON source, Save must reload layer data from SQLite and make the object visible without an application restart.
